marketplace.name: anthropica
marketplace.description: Role-based Claude skill packs for engineering, DevOps, infrastructure, design, marketing, SEO, QA and security teams.

phases.name: plan
phases.title: Plan
phases.when: Understand the code, requirements, risks and approach before changing anything.

phases.name: test
phases.title: Test
phases.when: Prove the change works, including under load.

phases.name: review
phases.title: Review
phases.when: Get the change or content reviewed before it merges or publishes.

phases.name: secure
phases.title: Secure
phases.when: Check code, dependencies and repository settings for security gaps.

phases.name: ship
phases.title: Ship
phases.when: Run pipelines, decide go/no-go and release.

phases.name: operate
phases.title: Operate
phases.when: Monitor production and respond to incidents; feed what you learn back into Plan.

phases.name: core
phases.title: Any phase
phases.when: Cross-cutting skills for documentation, prompts and token use.
